entities.name: Otto von Bismarck
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: The "Iron Chancellor" (1815–1898) who unified Germany through "blood and iron." As Minister-President of Prussia and first Chancellor of the German Empire, he engineered three wars, created a European alliance system, and forged modern Germany.
